mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 2.2 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2200.0, or the average 60-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 110.0, or the average 20-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential construction starts indicates a broad-based demand surge that boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL above 2.0% year-over-year signals a persistent inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth above 200k signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term in a predictive model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 11250 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 11250.0, or the average 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
